situations.title: 인공호흡기 설정 확인·기록
situations.tagline: Hey, can you double-check the vent settings with me before we chart them?
situations.brief: 모드, TV, FiO2, PEEP를 순서대로 점검하고 정확히 기록하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's confirm the mode, tidal volume, FiO2, and PEEP together.
I'll read the numbers off and you verify them on the flowsheet.
The FiO2 is set at 40 percent with a PEEP of 5.
goals: 인공호흡기 핵심 설정 항목을 빠짐없이 확인한다
확인한 값을 정확한 용어로 기록하고 공유한다

situations.title: 기관튜브 위치·고정 확인
situations.tagline: Is the breathing tube still in the right spot? I keep worrying it'll slip.
situations.brief: cuff 압력, 삽관 깊이, 튜브 고정 상태를 확인하고 가족에게 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: The tube is marked at 22 centimeters at his lip, which is where it should be.
I'm checking the cuff pressure so it seals without hurting him.
The tape is secure, so the tube won't move out of place.
goals: 튜브 깊이와 cuff 상태를 표준 방법으로 확인한다
가족이 안심하도록 고정 상태를 쉽게 설명한다

situations.title: 회로 연결·습화 점검
situations.tagline: There's water pooling in this tubing — is that going to be a problem?
situations.brief: 회로 누출과 물고임을 점검하고 습화 상태를 안전하게 유지하세요.
keyPhrases: That condensation is normal, and I'll drain it away from him.
I'm checking every connection so there are no leaks in the circuit.
The humidifier keeps his airway from drying out.
goals: 회로 누출과 물고임을 점검하고 조치한다
습화 장치의 목적을 가족에게 설명한다

situations.title: 호흡음·흉곽 상승 사정
situations.tagline: The night nurse said his left side wasn't moving as well — can you listen again?
situations.brief: 양측 호흡음과 흉곽 상승을 사정해 균등 환기를 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll listen to both lungs and watch how the chest rises.
Breath sounds are equal on both sides right now.
If one side sounds diminished, I'll check the tube depth.
goals: 양측 호흡음과 흉곽 상승을 체계적으로 사정한다
비대칭 소견 시 다음 확인 단계를 판단한다

situations.title: SpO2·EtCO2 모니터
situations.tagline: His oxygen number dipped a little — should we be doing anything?
situations.brief: SpO2와 EtCO2 지표를 해석해 산소화와 환기 상태를 함께 판단하세요.
keyPhrases: His oxygen is at 96 percent, which is a good number for him.
This second value shows how well he's clearing carbon dioxide.
I'm watching both numbers closely and they're stable.
goals: SpO2와 EtCO2가 각각 무엇을 의미하는지 구분한다
지표 변화를 가족에게 안심되게 설명한다

situations.title: 기관 흡인 협조
situations.tagline: Can you bump his oxygen up first? I'm going to suction him now.
situations.brief: 무균 흡인 전 전산소화를 하고 흡인 절차에 협조하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll pre-oxygenate him before you pass the catheter.
Let's keep this sterile so we don't introduce any infection.
Watch his oxygen while I suction, and stop if he desaturates.
goals: 흡인 전 전산소화의 필요성을 이해하고 수행한다
무균 술기로 흡인을 협조한다

situations.title: 모드 전환 이해
situations.tagline: The doctor switched him from AC to SIMV — what does that actually change for him?
situations.brief: AC, SIMV, PSV의 목적과 환자 반응 차이를 설명하고 관찰하세요.
keyPhrases: This new mode lets him take some of his own breaths.
We're gradually letting him do more of the work of breathing.
I'll watch how he tolerates the change over the next hour.
goals: 주요 환기 모드의 목적 차이를 설명한다
모드 전환 후 환자 반응을 관찰하고 판단한다

situations.title: PEEP 적정 산소화 개선
situations.tagline: They keep adjusting that pressure setting — is his oxygen finally getting better?
situations.brief: PEEP titration 과정을 이해하고 산소화 개선 반응을 평가하세요.
keyPhrases: We're fine-tuning the pressure to keep his lungs open.
After raising the PEEP, his oxygen improved to a safer level.
We change it in small steps and watch how he responds.
goals: PEEP titration의 목적과 방법을 이해한다
조정 후 산소화 반응을 지표로 평가한다

situations.title: 기도내압 상승 경보 감별
situations.tagline: That high-pressure alarm won't stop — what's making it go off?
situations.brief: 저항과 순응도 원인을 구분해 기도내압 상승 경보를 단계적으로 감별하세요.
keyPhrases: That alarm tells me his airway pressure is high, so I'm finding out why.
I'll check if the tube is kinked or if he needs suctioning first.
He's still getting oxygen while I work through the causes.
goals: 고압 알람의 저항성과 순응도 원인을 구분한다
원인별 대응을 순서대로 시행하고 보고한다

situations.title: 인공호흡기 부조화 인지
situations.tagline: He looks like he's fighting the machine — is he uncomfortable?
situations.brief: trigger와 flow 부조화를 인지해 환자-인공호흡기 비동기를 파악하세요.
keyPhrases: It looks like his breathing and the machine aren't quite in sync.
I'll adjust the trigger and flow so it matches his effort better.
We want the ventilator to work with him, not against him.
goals: trigger와 flow 부조화의 징후를 인지한다
부조화 원인을 파형과 함께 판단한다

situations.title: 폐보호 환기 적용
situations.tagline: Why is the machine giving him such small breaths now?
situations.brief: 저 TV와 plateau압 관리를 통한 폐보호 환기의 원리를 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Smaller breaths actually protect his injured lungs from more damage.
We keep the plateau pressure low to avoid overstretching the lungs.
It feels counterintuitive, but gentle ventilation helps him heal.
goals: 저 TV 폐보호 환기의 원리를 설명한다
plateau압 관리의 안전 목표를 이해한다

situations.title: 자발호흡 능력 사정
situations.tagline: Can you take a look — do you think he's ready to breathe more on his own?
situations.brief: RSBI와 호흡노력을 평가해 자발호흡 능력을 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's check his RSBI to see how well he's breathing on his own.
I'm watching his rate and effort during this spontaneous trial.
His numbers look promising, so I'll flag him for the team.
goals: RSBI로 자발호흡 능력을 정량적으로 평가한다
호흡노력 징후를 통합해 판단한다

situations.title: permissive hypercapnia 이해
situations.tagline: His carbon dioxide is high — shouldn't you be worried about that?
situations.brief: pH 허용범위를 소통하며 permissive hypercapnia의 근거를 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: We're allowing his carbon dioxide to run a bit high on purpose.
As long as his blood pH stays in a safe range, this protects his lungs.
It's a deliberate trade-off, and we're monitoring it closely.
goals: permissive hypercapnia의 근거를 설명한다
허용 가능한 pH 범위를 가족과 소통한다

situations.title: 흡인 후 산소화 회복 관리
situations.tagline: His oxygen dropped right after suctioning — is he okay?
situations.brief: 흡인 후 desaturation에 대응해 산소화 회복을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: A brief oxygen dip after suctioning is common, and I'm helping him recover.
I'll give him a few extra breaths of oxygen to bring it back up.
His number is already climbing back to normal.
goals: 흡인 후 desaturation의 원인과 대응을 이해한다
산소화 회복 과정을 가족에게 설명한다

situations.title: ABG 통합 환기 조정 소통
situations.tagline: The latest gas came back — his CO2 is still climbing, should we change the vent?
situations.brief: ABG 결과를 통합해 설정 변경 필요성을 의사에게 보고하세요.
keyPhrases: His PaCO2 is up and his pH is dropping on this gas.
I'd suggest increasing the rate to improve his ventilation.
I'll call the physician with the numbers and my recommendation.
goals: ABG 결과를 환기 상태와 통합해 해석한다
설정 변경 제안을 근거와 함께 보고한다

situations.title: 급성 산소포화도 붕괴 DOPE 감별
situations.tagline: His sats are crashing — the alarms are all going off, what do we do?!
situations.brief: DOPE 순서로 튜브, 폐색, 기흉, 장비 원인을 신속히 감별하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's run DOPE — check displacement, obstruction, pneumothorax, equipment.
Disconnect from the vent and bag him with 100 percent oxygen now.
I'll listen for equal breath sounds while you check the tube.
goals: DOPE 순서로 급성 산소포화도 붕괴 원인을 감별한다
감별 중 수동 환기로 산소화를 유지한다

situations.title: 고평탄압 기흉 위기
situations.tagline: His plateau pressure just shot up and his chest looks uneven — I think it's a pneumothorax.
situations.brief: 기압손상을 인지하고 긴장성 기흉 감압을 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: Diminished breath sounds and high pressures point to a pneumothorax.
I'm calling the physician and setting up for needle decompression.
Get the chest tube tray ready while we bag him carefully.
goals: 기압손상과 기흉의 위기 징후를 인지한다
감압 처치를 신속히 준비하고 보고한다

situations.title: 인공호흡기 완전 고장 수동 환기
situations.tagline: The ventilator just died — grab the bag, we have to breathe for him by hand!
situations.brief: 인공호흡기 고장 시 즉시 bag 환기로 전환하고 백업을 확보하세요.
keyPhrases: Disconnect and start bagging him with the resuscitation bag now.
I'll call respiratory for a backup ventilator immediately.
Keep a steady rate while I get help to the bedside.
goals: 인공호흡기 고장 시 즉시 수동 환기로 전환한다
백업 장비 확보와 인력 요청을 동시에 수행한다

situations.title: 우발적 자가발관 대응
situations.tagline: He pulled his tube out — he's gasping, we need help in here now!
situations.brief: 우발적 자가발관에 대응해 산소화를 유지하고 재삽관을 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: He self-extubated — start bag-mask ventilation with 100 percent oxygen.
Call the airway team and bring the intubation cart in.
I'll assess his own breathing while we prepare to reintubate.
goals: 우발적 자가발관 시 즉시 산소화를 확보한다
재삽관 필요성을 판단하고 준비한다

situations.title: 심한 부조화 진정 심화 판단
situations.tagline: He's completely fighting the vent and desatting — do we need to deepen his sedation?
situations.brief: 심한 부조화 상황에서 진정 심화 필요성을 판단하고 위기 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: He's severely dyssynchronous and his oxygen is falling.
I think we need to deepen sedation and possibly paralyze him.
I'll page the intensivist while you draw up the medication.
goals: 심한 부조화 위기의 진정 심화 필요성을 판단한다
처치 결정을 팀과 신속히 소통한다

situations.title: 난치성 저산소증 구조요법 전환
situations.tagline: We've maxed out the vent and he's still hypoxic — is it time to talk proning or ECMO?
situations.brief: 난치성 저산소증에서 proning과 ECMO 에스컬레이션을 판단하고 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: His oxygenation isn't responding despite maximal ventilator support.
We should escalate to proning and consult the ECMO team.
I'll gather his latest gases and P/F ratio for the call.
goals: 난치성 저산소증에서 구조요법 전환 시점을 판단한다
proning과 ECMO 에스컬레이션을 팀과 소통한다
